plugins.description: v7.6.0 (2026-05-22, MINOR — Paperclip integration layer): references/paperclip/ ships 14 docs + 11 custom skills enabling the plugin to run inside Paperclip (paperclip.ing) via claude_local adapter with effective parity to Claude Code standalone. Includes PAPERCLIP-AXIOMS.md (inquebravel contract + 4 axioms), 6 prompt-native workflow specs (PAPERCLIP-{BUGFIX,FEATURE,AUDIT,UX,SPEC,ADVERSARIAL}-WORKFLOW.md), 11 skill wrappers (engineering-principles canonical + 10 pipeline-orchestrator-*), paperclip-kb.md, paperclip-catalog.md, paperclip-adaptation-spec.md, ZONING.md, PLAN-46-AGENTS-UPDATE.md, pilot-information-gate.md (PARITY_VERDICT=PASS_WITH_NOTES, end-to-end validation), install-junctions.bat (Windows deployment), new /pipeline-orchestrator:setup-paperclip slash command (orchestrates detect+install+configure end-to-end) and docs/PAPERCLIP-INTEGRATION.md (architecture + setup + known gaps overview). Iron Law respected: ZERO changes to existing agents/, skills/, references/ (paperclip/ is additive subdir), commands/, or lib/. 23-row Mandatory Gates and 35-row Registry untouched. Backward compat 100%. v7.5.0 (2026-05-22, MINOR — concurrent-safe tracing): isolates concurrent pipeline runs sharing a working directory so trace/span carriers, manifest allocation, and sentinel state discovery no longer collide on PPID or mtime heuristics. lib/run-directory.cjs::allocate switches the primary mkdir from {recursive:true} to {recursive:false} and retries on EEXIST with a fresh collision-resistant uniqueId (Date.now base36 + crypto.randomBytes(6).hex); resulting runId `${ordinal}-${uniqueId}-${slug}` is published on process.env.PIPELINE_RUN_ID so descendant processes (langfuse-hook, sentinel-hook, stop-hook) key per-run state off the env-var instead of process.ppid or mtime. All three hooks fall back gracefully when PIPELINE_RUN_ID is absent, emitting one-shot AUDIT events (CARRIER_PPID_FALLBACK / DISCOVERY_RUN_ID_NO_MATCH / DISCOVERY_MTIME_FALLBACK). New PIPELINE_TRACING_SCOPE env-var (`agent-only` default = v7.4.0 parity / `agent-plus-skill` / `full`) replaces the silent `tool !== 'Agent'` filter; unknown values safe-default with AUDIT TRACING_SCOPE_UNKNOWN. Codex mirror byte-identical per Iron Law. 5 new regression tests (F1-F5, 44 sub-assertions, 100% GREEN). references/audit-trail.md gains Concurrency Invariants + Tracing Scope Policy + AUDIT events catalog; references/sentinel-integration.md gains State Discovery Contract. Backward-compat preserved end-to-end. v7.4.2 (2026-05-22, PATCH — Langfuse SDK vendored: bundles langfuse@3.38.4 + langfuse-core@3.38.20 + mustache@4.2.0 into the package so the cache works without a global install; closes Cannot find module 'langfuse' in marketplace cache). Single-command multi-agent pipeline for Claude Code. v7.2.0 (2026-05-21) — MINOR. Phase 0 hardening across 4 batches with ATDD/BDD/DDD per scenario + adversarial review per batch (22 findings: 3 CRITICAL fixed, 12 HIGH fixed, 5 MEDIUM fixed). (1) STATE_FILE_INIT_FAIL (CIRCUIT_BREAKER): hard precondition on initial sentinel-state.json write; controller emits PASS on healthy init AND BLOCKED on Write/verify failure before any Agent spawn — no PASS verdicts over missing state. (2) PROTOCOL_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT (HARD): two-layer detection — primary out-of-band hook fires on every SessionStart (closes Achado #7 circularity where a broken parent never re-dispatches) + secondary controller re-entry check (defense-in-depth). Default 30min; env override PIPELINE_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_MS with 60000ms sanity floor; cross-session pending_blocks demoted to SOFT/CLEARED_CROSS_SESSION. (3) cleanup-orphan-sentinel-state-hook (.claude/hooks/, SessionStart): auto-archives sentinel-state.json older than 24h via atomic rename to sentinel-state.archived-<ts>.json (closes Achado B1-001 manual workaround); sandbox-checked cwd (deny-list + realpath), depth-limited walk (max 10), symlink-skip, mtime CAS. (4) --strict-spec flag: rejects Signal 3 (prose regex) and Signal 4 (glob fallback) Spec detection in unattended/CI mode where AskUserQuestion is unavailable; preserves Signal 1 (path arg) and Signal 2 (--type=spec); prefix-line anti-injection; precedence over conflicting FORCE_VARIANT=spec-*; STRICT_SPEC_REJECTION gate (AUDIT) logged. Gate Registry 32 → 35 (Core 16→18 + Routing 3→4). Mandatory Gates 22 → 23. Suite 45/46 green. All changes additive with backward compatibility. v7.1.1 (2026-05-21) — PATCH (docs only). Enriches docs/diagrams/pipeline-overview.html with Fluxos detalhados ponta a ponta section. v7.1.0 (2026-05-19) — MINOR. Telemetry hygiene: new lib/gate-decision-writer.cjs SSOT writer + canonical 8-value decision vocabulary (BLOCKED/DISPATCHED/SKIPPED/APPROVED/CONFIRMED/REJECTED/TRIGGERED/NOT_TRIGGERED) with runtime throw on unknown values; every gate event auto-carries run_id/plugin_version/schema_version/type/complexity correlation envelope. New Stop hook (.claude/hooks/stop-hook.cjs) registered in .claude/settings.json fires appendRunLog on every session end including crashes — closes the 1-line-per-20-runs aggregate bug. fidelity-reporter VALID_HARDNESS gains AUDIT; VALID_DECISION widened; invalid values surface in warnings[] instead of silent '(invalid)'. 7 regression tests in tests/regression/v7.1.0/. 22-row Mandatory Gates and 27-row Registry untouched. v7.0.0 (2026-05-19) — MAJOR (license-only): licensed under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 (source-available, noncompete clause). All v7.0.0 code is identical to v6.3.0; the major bump signals license-only change per SemVer convention. See LICENSE and NOTICE.md. v6.3.0 (2026-05-19) — MINOR. Implementation Discipline Layer: new SSOT references/implementation-discipline.md (scope control, minimal diff, SOLID/KISS/DRY/YAGNI, dependency/config/contract/migration restrictions, test integrity, evidence requirements, severity PASS/NEEDS_REDUCTION/REJECTED). plan-architect emits CHANGE_CONTRACT inline in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN. executor-implementer-task gains SCOPE LOCK CHECK before every Write/Edit (Read remains free). New agent agents/quality/diff-discipline-reviewer.md (tools=Read,Grep,Glob; static-only; max_fix_attempts=5 independent from ADVERSARIAL_BLOCK max=3). review-orchestrator wires diff-discipline as third parallel reviewer with dual fix_loop_counters. architecture-reviewer +5 new checks. 7 regression tests in tests/regression/v6.3.0/ (F8-F14). 22-row Mandatory Gates by Complexity invariant preserved; Registry stays at 27 rows. Bootstrap exception: v6.3.0 itself created the enforcement machinery — T1-T3 ran without SCOPE LOCK CHECK enforcement; T4+ enforced; future releases inherit fully-enforced pipeline. v6.2.0 (2026-05-18) — MINOR. Pre-execution clarification overhaul: replaces the fixed 7-question brainstorm template with a 4-phase dynamic agent (Phase A reads project context + likely-affected files BEFORE any question; Phase B inventories gaps across 11 lenses + domain extensions for auth/payment/PII/migration/concurrency; Phase C asks one GATE_REQUEST per real gap with mandatory file:line evidence; Phase D records 02-explore.md + emits structured JSONL telemetry). New step-01b-alternatives agent: proposes 2-4 alternative approaches after clarification (Minimal/Pattern-aligned/Aggressive/Contrarian axes), auto-skip rule for mechanical tasks. Drift fix on references/complexity-matrix.md (Has spec for MEDIA changed from 'Optional' to 'Required (auto-dispatch)', matching pipeline-controller.md:281 runtime). 5 new gates (CLARIFICATION_GAPS_DETECTED/RESOLVED/SKIPPED + ALTERNATIVES_PROPOSED/CHOSEN) plus AUDIT hardness level for telemetry-only events. Gate registry 22 → 27. Brainstorm controller step table 9 → 10. Dogfood evidence: docs/audits/2026-05-18-clarification-overhaul-dogfood/ (real MEDIA scenario against IFRS 16 contracts.py:232; 14 telemetry events; 4 anti-invention blockers surfaced — streaming/PII/cap/timeout — that the legacy template would have left for downstream invention). Backward compat preserved (legacy pipeline-runs/ resume cleanly via missing-field handling on notes.options.alternatives_done). v6.1.0 (2026-05-15) — MINOR. ATDD/BDD/DDD workflow contracts added as output requirements (SOFT enforcement, legacy pipelines preserved): D5 ATDD non-spec Given/When/Then branch in quality-gate-router Step 1b (EARS And/But continuations allowed, MEDIA/COMPLEXA only; SIMPLES/Spec exempt); D6 BDD Gherkin emission per slice in feature-vertical-slice-planner Step 3b (flat naming .pipeline/artifacts/bdd/SLICE-NN.feature); D7 DDD lightweight Bounded Contexts section in plan-architect (3-column COMPLEXA-only contract with new Rule 10 emitting BOUNDED_CONTEXT_MISSING event via canonical ALLOWED_PROTOCOL_EVENT_KEYS schema; producer wiring v6.2 forward-dependency). 4 new regression tests in tests/regression/v6.1.0/ (D5/D6/D7/B4 = 37 scenarios). 22-gate registry preserved (event reuses SOFT mechanism). Suite: 19/0/19 GREEN. Forward dependencies for v6.2 documented in CHANGELOG. v6.0.0 (2026-05-15) — MAJOR RELEASE. Comprehensive audit + hardening cycle over IFRS 16 reference project: 12/12 CRITICAL findings resolved (100%), 22/22 gate registry entries exercised in runtime, 16 subagents declare Achado #7 protocol explicitly, 3 new security mitigation libraries (HMAC sentinel-state signature, JSONL sanitization parser, pipeline.local.md sandbox parser), 39 regression tests in tests/regression/v6.0.0/, audit reports archived in docs/audits/2026-05-15-ifrs16-deep-audit/. Visual documentation overhaul with HTML/SVG flowcharts in docs/diagrams/. Effective audit coverage 30% → 95%. Breaking changes: STALE_THRESHOLD_MS constants renamed to canonical STALE_SPAWN_THRESHOLD_MS / STALE_HEARTBEAT_THRESHOLD_MS (aliases preserved until v6.1.0). Migration: hooks consumers should switch to new names; no behavioral change. v5.2.0 (2026-05-08, promoted from v5.2.0-rc.2 with same content; user authorized direct promotion for marketplace distribution). v5.2.0-rc.2 (2026-05-08) — Achado #7 protocol adoption expanded to 5 SKILLs + brainstorm-controller step agents + 9 pipeline-controller dispatch sites with concrete YAML examples. Closes 3 protocol-coverage lacunas post-rc.1. +4 contract tests, 0 regressions. v5.2.0-rc.1 (2026-05-07) — Achados 1-7 reconciliation + GATE_REQUEST/DISPATCH_REQUEST protocol. Closes 7 contract drift findings from a v5.1.0 dogfood adversarial review. Achado 7 is architectural: empirical probe confirmed Claude Code harness strips AskUserQuestion/Agent/EnterPlanMode from subagent tool manifests; mitigation via emit-and-hoist protocol (3 new block schemas in references/gate-request-protocol.md), adopted in pipeline-controller / brainstorm-controller / executor-controller. Protocol entries live in protocol-events.jsonl (separate from gate-decisions.jsonl). +13 contract tests, 0 regressions. 5 follow-ups deferred to v5.2 final. v5.0.0 — first major release. All 7 v5.0 DoD criteria DONE: 5 commands in /help, TRACE.md by default, TRACE.md attachable to PR via standalone validator, compat suite green for 5 canonical scenarios, v5.1 milestone published with YAML interpreter commitment (milestone #1, target Q3 2026), plan-mode-enforcer auto-triggers on MEDIA + COMPLEXA, pipeline-controller declares spawn tools explicitly. Suite at v5.0.0: 166 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 SKIPPED unit+integration + 5 PASS / 1 SKIPPED compat mock + 8/8 hooks syntax. The v5.0.0 release content is identical to v5.0.0-rc.1 (`d643e80`) — promotion was authorized 2026-05-06. v4.17.0 (Wave 8-spec — TRACE.md schema + writer + standalone validator + plan-mode auto-trigger + --no-plan bypass): closes 3 v5.0 DoD criteria in one wave (#2 TRACE.md by default in user repo, #3 attachable to PR via standalone validator, #6 plan-mode-enforcer auto-triggers on MEDIA + COMPLEXA with asymmetric --no-plan override semantics — COMPLEXA always runs plan-architect, override flag is logged for audit). Adds references/trace-schema/v1.md (SSOT, schema_version=1), scripts/validate-trace.cjs (pure-Node validator, exit 0/1 with stderr diff), tests/integration/trace-writer.test.js (7 tests), tests/unit/validate-trace.test.js (5 tests), tests/unit/plan-mode-trigger.test.js (5 tests, 4-combination matrix). Modifies agents/core/pipeline-controller.md Phase 3 closure with new Step 3b-post (TRACE.md emitter wired between final-validator and finishing-branch); modifies commands/pipeline.md Phase 1.5 trigger; corrects designs/pipeline-orchestrator-v5-consolidated.md §8 prose. Iron Law respected: ZERO changes to gate registry (still 22 in references/gates.md), sentinel checkpoints, or agent dispatch namespace; default behavior (no --no-plan) preserves v4.16.0 EXACTLY for SIMPLES and COMPLEXA; MEDIA gets plan-architect for the FIRST TIME (additive). Suite stays GREEN: 166 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 SKIPPED unit+integration (+17 from v4.16.0 baseline) + 5 PASS / 1 SKIPPED compat mock + 8/8 hooks syntax. v4.16.0 (Wave 8-pre): real-mode compat runner via PreToolUse hook contract (Issue #11). v4.15.0 (Wave 7-spec): MIGRATION-v4-to-v5.md + v5 readiness report. v4.14.0 (Wave 6-spec): integration tests + bad-variant fixtures. v4.13.0 (Wave 5-spec): gates registry +6, Inline Invariants 22, mode_used persistence. v4.12.0 (Wave 4-spec): /spec entry-point + 3 pipeline composition refs. v4.11.0 (Wave 3-spec): Spec Classifier Routing. v4.10.0 (Wave 3): Compat Baselines. v4.9.x: spec workflow polish + CI debt. v4.9.0: Spec Workflow Wave 2 — 3 skill trees. v4.8.0 (Hook Enforcement). v4.7.0 (Slice 3b polish). v4.6.1 (Slice 3b corrected). v4.5.0 (Slice 3a). v4.4.x (Slice 1.5). v4.3.x (skill migration). v4.2.x (SEC + thin entry-points). DoD v5.0 status post-Wave-8-spec: 7/7 DONE — v5.0.0-rc.1 tagged 2026-05-06 (1-2 week feedback window, then v5.0.0 final).

Hot-path hook 387→85 lines via lib/advisor-nudge-core extraction; 4 architectural guards CI-enforced (DI-1 module-load purity, DI-2 layered dependency direction, DI-3 manifest version coherence, vault env single source); module-scoped mtime+size cache for embeddings/graph; unified filesystem walker; 812 tests (+24% from 654). BREAKING (restorable): default prompt-length threshold 5→12 chars; restore via ADVISOR_PROMPT_LENGTH=5. Deprecation runway through 0.6.0 for SKILL_ADVISOR_VAULT (use SKILL_ADVISOR_VAULT_PATH) and build-index.inferCategory re-export.
